difficulty_reason: Cut G by the distinguished triangle G -> Rj'_*G|_V -> Q -> G[1] with Q supported on f^{-1}Z; apply Rf_*, take stalks at x-bar to get the four-term exact sequence, and compare with the pointwise sequence at y-bar; the middle identification Q_y = (Rf_*Q)_x is exactly lemma-stalk-pushforward-with-support (same wave), whence the kernel map is an isomorphism and the cokernel map injective.
